claims.text: The resort is a Walt Disney World Gateway Hotel, offering convenient access to Walt Disney World Resort and Disney Springs.

findings.quote: As a Walt Disney World Gateway Hotel, we offer our guests convenient access to Walt Disney World Resort, and Disney Springs

claims.text: Rooms look out over Bonnet Creek Preserve and the surrounding Disney parks.

findings.quote: invite guests to take in the views of Bonnet Creek Preserve and surrounding Disney parks

claims.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows that overlook the resort's two pools and can offer a glimpse of Epcot's nightly fireworks.

findings.quote: Floor-to-ceiling windows allow you to bask in the warm Florida sunlight, overlook our two sparkling pools, and even enjoy your personal glimpse of Epcot's nightly fireworks display.

claims.text: Spa by JW is a day spa with treatment rooms and express pods.

findings.quote: Rejuvenate in our 9,920-square-foot day spa in Orlando, FL. The luxury spa at our resort near Walt Disney World features 10 treatment rooms and express pods.

claims.text: A full-service beauty salon sits next to Spa by JW.

findings.quote: Adjacent to the Spa by JW you will find our full-service beauty salon

claims.text: Guests can reserve a private poolside cabana or daybed with a personal attendant and a seasonal fruit plate.

findings.quote: in your own personal cabana or daybed. Enjoy luxurious amenities like a seasonal fruit plate, your own personal attendant and more while relaxing on chaise loungers. Reserve your cabana easily online here.

claims.text: Daily wellness classes, from yoga to HIIT, are held at Motion Studio on the 3rd floor.

findings.quote: Revitalize with daily wellness classes, ranging from yoga to HIIT, guided by expert wellness instructors at Motion Studio on the 3rd floor

claims.text: Hidden Garden Kids Club offers supervised themed daily adventures for children aged 5 to 12.

findings.quote: Hidden Garden Kids ClubAn endless range of activities and themed daily adventures for our youngest guests aged 5-12. Supervised morning, afternoon, all-day and evening slots available.

claims.text: Guests can write letters to the fairies and pick up a fairy mail reply, covered in fairy dust, at the front desk.

findings.quote: Guests can even write letters to the fairies, and guests can pick up their fairy mail response, covered in fairy dust, at the front desk.

claims.text: The garden's signature rosemary features in dishes at Sear + Sea Woodfire Grill and in cocktails at UnReserved and Sear + Sea Lobby Bar.

findings.quote: you will find our signature ingredient, rosemary, in specialty items at Sear + Sea Woodfire Grill and artistic cocktails at UnReserved and Sear + Sea Lobby Bar.

claims.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows that overlook the resort's two pools and can offer a glimpse of Epcot's nightly fireworks.

findings.quote: Floor-to-ceiling windows allow you to bask in the warm Florida sunlight, overlook our two sparkling pools, and even enjoy your personal glimpse of Epcot's nightly fireworks display.

claims.text: A Fairy Door Scavenger Hunt hides little fairy doors throughout the hotel and the surrounding Bonnet Creek preserve.

findings.quote: Fairy Door Scavenger Hunt
fairies are real and live throughout the hotel and the surrounding Bonnet Creek preserve. You can spy their little doors everywhere

claims.text: Family loft suites have kid-friendly loft beds and ample space to play.

findings.quote: our family hotel suites near Disney World Orlando have kid-friendly loft beds, ample space to play

claims.text: Family activities include the Mount Chelonia rock-climbing wall, rooftop garden golf and a kids and teen activity center on the 6th floor.

findings.quote: From our Mount Chelonia rock-climbing wall, to our rooftop Garden golf or our kids and teen activity center located on the 6th floor, we inspire family fun.

claims.text: The JW Garden is an herb and citrus filled garden with lush greens and local pollinators.

findings.quote: Our herb and citrus filled oasis invites guests to slow down, reflect, and enjoy nature amid lush greens, sweet scents, and an array of local pollinators.

claims.text: Hidden Garden Kids Club requires reservations.

findings.quote: Supervised morning, afternoon, all-day and evening slots available. Reservations required.

claims.text: The rock wall and garden golf require reservations, and age and weight rules apply.

findings.quote: Enjoy Rock Wall and Garden Golf.
Reservations required, age & weight rules apply.

claims.text: A daily resort fee applies, and its rate and inclusions are subject to change.

findings.quote: Fee is currently $55 daily, excluding tax. Resort fee rate and inclusions subject to change.
